items.s: 研究达赖喇嘛转世历史的学者索朗多吉在新作中预测，中共将来即可能试图滥用，并操弄拉姆拉措湖的观湖程序。但索朗多吉指出，达赖喇嘛转世的感应与认定，绝不局限于单一的地理湖泊。

items.s: 联合国有关“致命性自主武器系统”(LAWS)谈判经过连续几个小时的密集磋商后于星期六(11月21日)凌晨在日内瓦闭幕。虽然与会各方同意在未来两年内继续讨论制定相关的新规则，但是外交官们未能就启动具有法律约束力的禁令谈判获得授权。

教宗乌尔班二世在法国克莱蒙会议发表演说，号召基督教徒前去征讨进攻拜占庭帝国的穆斯林。
瑞典化学家阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔在法国巴黎签署最后遗嘱，使用其大部分遗产设立诺贝尔奖。

en.t: Jin–Song wars: A Song fleet, equiped with trebuchets that launched incendiary bombs, defeated Jin ships in a naval engagement on the Yangtze River.
William III unilaterally revised the constitution of Luxembourg, greatly expanding his powers as grand duke.
World War II: Australian forces began the Battle of Wareo by conducting clearing operations between Bonga and North Hill.

President Lyndon B. Johnson delivered the "Let Us Continue" speech, in which he advocated for civil-rights legislation and national cohesion, to a joint session of the U.S. Congress five days after the assassination of John F. Kennedy.
Astronomers announced the detection of sodium in the atmosphere of the extrasolar planet HD 209458 b, the first exoplanet atmosphere to be measured.
Nuclear physicist Mohsen Fakhrizadeh, regarded as the chief of Iran's nuclear program, was assassinated, allegedly by Mossad.

zh.t: 辽太宗派遣部队协助针对后唐皇帝李从珂的反叛行动后，册封石敬瑭为后晋皇帝。
斯坎德培假借奥斯曼帝国苏丹穆拉德二世的名义，率领阿尔巴尼亚骑兵占领克鲁亚。
波义耳与胡克等12名科学家于伦敦格雷沙姆学院决定组织学会，后来发展为皇家学会。
南希·阿斯特正式就任英国下议院议员，成为英国史上首位女性国会议员。
新西兰航空901号班机在南极洲埃里伯斯火山撞山坠毁，机上257人全部罹难。

en.t: Having deserted the Ottoman army, Skanderbeg arrived in the Albanian city of Krujë and, using a forged letter from Sultan Murad II to the governor of Krujë, became lord of the city.
The Scots Army led by Tam Dalyell of the Binns suppressed an uprising by Covenanter insurgents under James Wallace of Auchens near the Pentland Hills in Scotland.
The Chicago Times-Herald race, the first automobile race in the U.S., was held in Chicago.
In a military coup, Michel Micombero abolished the Burundian monarchy and declared the country a republic with himself as the inaugural president.
Air New Zealand Flight 901 crashed into Antarctica's Mount Erebus, killing all 257 people on board.
LaMia Flight 2933 crashed near Medellín, Colombia, killing 71 people, many of whom were players from Chapecoense Football Club.

zh.t: 西班牙美洲殖民地在墨西哥成立上加利福尼亚省第一座农业城镇圣何塞。
随着《大日本帝国宪法》正式生效，采取两院制的最高立法机构帝国议会召开首次会议。
瑞士企业家胡安·甘伯在西班牙巴塞罗那成立巴塞罗那足球俱乐部。
联合国大会通过第181号决议，于巴勒斯坦地区分别建立犹太人国家及阿拉伯人国家。
大韩航空858号班机因被两名朝鲜特工安放定时炸弹而于安达曼海上空爆炸，机上115人全数罹难。

en.t: The Abbasid Caliphate captured the Qarmatian leadership at the Battle of Hama in Syria, opening the way for the reconquest of Tulunid Egypt.
Napoleonic Wars: British troops rendezvoused at Grand Baie to launch an invasion of Isle de France, now known as Mauritius.
FC Barcelona, one of the most successful clubs in Spanish football, was founded by Swiss football pioneer Joan Gamper.
Five minutes after taking off from Montréal–Dorval, Trans-Canada Air Lines Flight 831 crashed in bad weather, killing all 118 people on board.
Michael Jackson's Thriller, the best-selling album of all time, was released.
In resolution 67/19, the United Nations General Assembly voted to accord the status of a non-member observer state to Palestine.
